release_notes.en-US: 0.3.0: the reading ruler gets controls — six colours (white for dark pages), three heights, opacity, and a lock that keeps the band where it is while you scroll (click or tap to move it). Also new: a wider-spacing switch with the dyslexia style-guide numbers (free) and a page tint — cream or a soft pastel instead of white (unlock). 0.2.1: works on Firefox for Android. The popup fits a phone screen, and the reading ruler and paragraph focus go where you tap. 0.2.0: reads web PDFs. Open a PDF, click the ReadFocus icon and choose "Read this PDF": the file opens in ReadFocus's own reader page as real text, so bold word starts, the ruler, paragraph focus and the dyslexia-friendly fonts all work on it. Free: the first page; the unlock reads the whole file. Local PDF files are not supported. Nothing leaves your browser.

summary.en-US: Bold word starts, a reading ruler, text size, paragraph focus and dyslexia fonts. Private: nothing leaves your browser.

description.en-US:
Long pages, short attention? ReadFocus makes reading on the web easier to start and easier to finish.

• Bold word starts — the first letters of every word are emphasised so your eyes land and glide. Light, medium or heavy.
• Reading ruler — a soft band that follows your mouse so you never lose the line.
• Text size — scale the page's reading text up to 150% without touching menus or editors.
• Per-site switch — on for the sites where you read, off everywhere else; runs only on sites you enable.
• Firefox for Android — same extension on your phone: tap the page to place the ruler.

Unlock ($12, once): precise bold coverage and weight, paragraph focus, and OpenDyslexic / Atkinson Hyperlegible fonts. One key for every browser; works offline; 14-day refund.

Private by design: no data collection, no network requests while you read; activating a paid key makes one request to confirm it.

Switching from Reader Mode or another focus-reading extension that stopped working? Side-by-side comparison: https://apps.gankdat.com/reader-mode-alternative.html
Looking for a reading ruler that works on PDFs? https://apps.gankdat.com/reading-ruler.html
